input.title: Checkout performance
input.description: Why mobile checkout takes more than 3 s and what to do.

blocks.title: Mobile checkout takes 3.4 s
blocks.markdown: Loading the payment SDK before showing the form takes 70 % of the time. Lazy-loading it and preloading the payment session would reduce the time below 1.5 s.

items.title: Blocking SDK
items.markdown: The payment script loads synchronously in the layout and blocks the first checkout render.

items.title: Late session
items.markdown: The payment session is created on selecting “Pay”, not on checkout entry, adding another API round trip.

blocks.markdown: Lighthouse measurement on a Moto G Power over slow 4G, five runs, median: LCP 3.4 s and TBT 610 ms. Performance profile shows 2.3 s downloading and evaluating the payment SDK before the form's first render.

items.title: Lazy-load the SDK
items.description: Move the payment script to the form component with lazy loading so the cart summary displays immediately.

items.title: Create the session on entry
items.description: Create the payment session when checkout mounts so “Pay” avoids another API round trip.

items.title: Measure again
items.description: Repeat measurement on the same device/network and record the result as a Knowledge fact.
